time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 at t = 0; container timestamps are uniform (512/12288 s steps)

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of background patches between consecutive frames: |shift| <= 0.1 px)

intrinsics_from_protocol.note: Orbbec Femto Mega RGB, f = 0.5959 x width

camera.view: high camera looking obliquely down onto a carpeted floor; right wall runs away from camera to upper-left
camera.post_processing: 'Segment Anything 2 Demo' effect: background heavily blurred, the ball and the two people kept sharp with a light glow/halo of ~5-10 px around the ball

right_wall_floor_junction_line.note: dark baseboard, measured on the median background; hidden behind receiver between x~950-1090

perspective_cues.far_floor_edge: reddish/brown band along y~170-200 from x~230 to ~700 (blurred, approximate)
perspective_cues.horizon: above the top of the image (camera pitched down)

ball.description: white football (soccer ball) with black pentagon panels and a black 'Franklin' logo panel; the only ball; thrown by the person on the left to the person on the right
ball.reference_point: visible centre = centre of the mask extent box

held_frames_0_16_sharp.note: ball near left image edge; off-axis projection stretches it ~10% along the radial (mostly horizontal) direction; bottom edge partly behind fingers

flight_streak_frames_27_35.note: motion blur streak along the motion direction; width across motion ~90-113

apparent_size_px.trend: apparent diameter shrinks from ~110-125 px (held, near camera) to ~65-70 px (at the receiver): ball ends ~1.7-1.8x farther from the camera than at the start

thrower.description: person on the left edge, light grey T-shirt, dark trousers, glasses, face blurred; only partly in frame (head, torso, arms); holds and throws the ball underhand
thrower.moves: torso nearly static; arms swing (wind-up frames 14-24, throw 25-30, arms extended after release)

receiver.description: person on the right standing by the wall, dark grey oversized T-shirt, black trousers with white drawstrings, white sneakers, long dark hair, face blurred; catches the ball
receiver.moves: feet static (shoe centroids drift <= 3 px, at the catch); arms rise from ~frame 36 and catch the ball at frames 43-44

image_extent_frame0_px.y_top: cut by image top (y=0, head partly outside)

receiver.note: full standing height NOT measurable: top of the head is at/above the image top edge

right_wall.description: light grey wall panel with dark baseboard on the right side

floor_marks.description: white tape mark at bottom right (x~880-980, y~650-700); small light strip at (x~620-700, y~395-410); reddish marks near the far wall; all blurred

background_clutter.description: blurred: exercise balls, a chair/table, seated people's legs, white box at top centre (x~600-660, y~40-130)

events.event: ball held in both hands of thrower at (317.5, 544.5)
small lift ends: ball highest in held phase (334.5, 518.5); direction reverses (wind-up starts ~frame 14-16)
lowest point of wind-up (272.5, 601.5); swing reverses to forward/upward
release (hand contact last seen frames 29-30; ball clearly free from frame 31; +-1 frame)
apex of the arc in the image (cy ~71.5 at frames 36-38)
ANOMALY: image step 35->36 (~93 px) is about twice the neighbouring steps (~50 and ~34 px); possibly a dropped capture frame between 35 and 36
catch contact: receiver's forearms touch the ball
ball secured between receiver's forearms/hands; then carried down-right to frame 48
